## Description

/admin/consent: consent templates per kind (treatment, recording, sharing, reminders, marketing) and language (EN/TA/HI/AR…) with versions (e.g. v2026.2); recording policy (audio retention days and purpose, who may record, devices allowed). Publishing a new version never changes old receipts.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Admin can draft, preview and publish a template version per language; published versions are immutable.
- [ ] **AC2.** Receipts reference the exact template version and language shown.
- [ ] **AC3.** Recording policy (retention days default 30, purpose "documentation only") is editable only by admins and audited.
- [ ] **AC4.** Recording consent script in the patient's language is served from the published template.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
